Bifidobacterium.title: Bifidobacterium
Bifidobacterium.description: Supports digestion, reduces inflammation and helps maintain gut barrier integrity. Certain strains can break down ellagitannins to ellagic acid (first step in Urolithin A formation).

areas.digestiveHealth: Promotes healthy digestion and regularity. Helps break down dietary fiber and produce beneficial short-chain fatty acids.
areas.immune: Enhances immune response and protects against pathogens.

Lactobacillus.title: Lactobacillus
Lactobacillus.description: Produces lactic acid, supports gut health, and inhibits harmful bacteria.

areas.digestiveHealth: Improves digestion, reduces bloating, and supports nutrient absorption.
areas.immune: Strengthens immune defense and reduces inflammation.

Akkermansia.title: Akkermansia
Akkermansia.description: Maintains gut lining and metabolic health.

areas.digestiveHealth: Improves gut barrier function and metabolic health.

Gordonibacter.title: Gordonibacter
Gordonibacter.description: Specialized gut bacterium. Converts ellagic acid (from pomegranate and berries) to Urolithin A, which supports mitochondrial and cellular health.

areas.digestiveHealth: Converts ellagic acid to Urolithin A, supporting gut and cellular health.
areas.energy: Produces Urolithin A, which supports mitochondrial function and energy metabolism.

Roseburia.title: Roseburia
Roseburia.description: Produces butyrate and supports anti-inflammatory effects.

areas.digestiveHealth: Promotes anti-inflammatory effects and gut health.

Ruminococcus.title: Ruminococcus
Ruminococcus.description: Breaks down complex carbohydrates and produces beneficial metabolites.

areas.digestiveHealth: Helps digest fiber and supports gut health.

Prevotella.title: Prevotella
Prevotella.description: Associated with plant-rich diets and fiber breakdown.

areas.digestiveHealth: Supports fiber breakdown and gut health.

Lawsinobacter_asaccharolyticus.title: Lawsinobacter asaccharolyticus
Lawsinobacter_asaccharolyticus.description: Emerging gut bacterium. May help break down fiber and produce butyrate (butyric acid), which is important for gut health.

areas.digestiveHealth: Potentially supports fiber breakdown and gut health through butyrate (butyric acid) production. More research needed.

Faecalibacterium.title: Faecalibacterium
Faecalibacterium.description: Produces butyrate (butyric acid), a key short-chain fatty acid for gut health. Butyrate nourishes colon cells, strengthens the gut barrier, and reduces inflammation. Lawsinobacter asaccharolyticus may also produce butyrate.

areas.digestiveHealth: Supports gut barrier, reduces inflammation, and promotes regularity. Butyrate (butyric acid) is essential for colon health and anti-inflammatory effects. Lawsinobacter asaccharolyticus may also produce butyrate.
